text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her relentless daily training bore fruit, 
and Mihono Bourbon went on to produce a 
splendid result in the Spring Stakes as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up is finally the first step toward 
achieving her dream. —The Satsuki Sho 
awaits.
